hooks.text: 九个世界各有独立剧情、任务线、敌人机制与通关规则
hooks.excerpt: each of the nine realms features its own story, questlines, enemy mechanics, and special rules. Every world offers a different pace, a different combat experience, and a different way to clear the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 40多种技能芯片可改变弹道与行为，68种血脉还能纯化进化或混合突变
hooks.excerpt: Over 40 hot-swappable chips can completely transform how your skills work. Insert chips into any skill to instantly alter its form, changing its trajectory, behavior, or projectile properties. Mix and match 68 bloodline powers to create unexpected synergies. Stack the same bloodline to trigger its pure-blood final evolution, or combine different bloodlines to unlock unpredictable mutations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次重生都会重排世界顺序，并改变支线、血脉掉落、事件与剧情分支
hooks.excerpt: With every rebirth, the order of the worlds changes. Each time you enter a world, you may encounter different side quests, bloodline drops, and events. Changes in world order can also affect branching storylines and how each realm develops.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
